name: The Phylactery Vault
intro: The jar's green fire flares and pulls you in after it. You stand in a stair of bone beneath the world, and every step down is a step into a dead man's mind.

rooms.name: The Phylactery Vault - The Ossuary Stair
rooms.description: A spiral stair carved from a single enormous bone winds down into the dark. Below, a door of fused vertebrae blocks the way north.

rooms.name: The Phylactery Vault - The Hall of Jars
rooms.description: Shelves of jars climb out of sight, each holding a flicker of green fire and a servant's name. North, a veil of grave-fire hangs across an archway.

rooms.name: The Phylactery Vault - The Throne of Xal'thar
rooms.description: A throne built of a thousand jars stands at the end of the hall. On it sits what is left of the first necromancer to cheat death.

waves.text: Phylactery wardens step out of the bone walls!
The jars on the shelves crack, and their servants crawl out!
Bound servants pour from the shattered jars!

gates.text: The bone door grinds open on the hall of jars.
The veil of grave-fire parts before the throne.

boss.text: Xal'thar the First Lich rises from his throne of jars. 'A thief,' he whispers, 'come to steal what I stole first. Kneel, and I will make you my jar.'
